events.verdict: Turner (MIL) aligns himself alongside Durant's (HOU) path and the contact during the drive is marginal.
Rollins (MIL) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Rollins (MIL) directly contests Durant's (HOU) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Durant's (HOU) hand after the release.
Smith Jr. (HOU) moves alongside Antetokounmpo's (MIL) path and the contact that occurs during the driving shot attempt is marginal.
There is no clear and conclusive camera angle that shows if Thompson (HOU) makes contact with the ball after the ball touches the backboard.
Rollins (MIL) cleanly deflects the ball away from Thompson (HOU) during rebounding.
Durant (HOU) swipes his arm down and initiates contact with Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm/wrist as he is starting his upward shooting motion.
Rollins (MIL) briefly grasps Smith Jr.'s (HOU) jersey as he secures the rebound.
Turner (MIL) and Sengun (HOU) briefly engage and disengage off ball.
Sengun (HOU) establishes his left foot as his pivot foot, which he maintains after his gather.
Sengun (HOU) brings his off-arm toward Antetokounmpo (MIL) as the contact that occurs during the shot attempt is marginal.
Durant (HOU) absorbs the contact from Antetokounmpo (MIL) as they come together at the end of the drive.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) momentarily applies his hand to Durant's (HOU) side before removing his hand.
Antetokounmpo (MIL) brushes Durant's (HOU) arm on the perimeter, which causes Durant to momentarily lose control of the ball before he quickly regains possession.
Durant (HOU) does not bring part of his hand under the ball when he resumes his dribble.
Trent Jr. (MIL) legally contests Okogie's (HOU) jump shot attempt.
Sengun (HOU) commits a take foul on Antetokounmpo (MIL).
Antetokounmpo (MIL) and Sengun (HOU) come together at the same spot on the perimeter, and the contact is marginal.
Turner (MIL) extends his left arm across Sengun's (HOU) upper body and initiates contact with his right shoulder during the shot attempt that is more than marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Replay review of the out of bounds called on Thompson (HOU) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful.  Green (MIL) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds. Possession is correctly awarded to the Rockets.
Green (MIL) commits a take foul on Durant (HOU).
Okogie (HOU) grabs and holds onto Antetokounmpo's (MIL) arm, which affects his control of the ball.
